application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a rear and side roof extensions with one front roof window.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unreferenced Location Plan; Proposed Loft Floor Plan & Existing & Proposed Roof Plan; Existing & Proposed Front Elevation; Existing GF Plan Existing & Proposed 1st Floor Plan; Existing & Proposed Section; Existing & Proposed Rear Elevation; Existing & Proposed East Elevation; Proposed Loft Floor Plan  Received:  16 December 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors and other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear and side roof extensions hereby approved.
Condition : 5 - The proposed side roof dormer extension's windows shall be obscure glazed, non-openable below 1.75 metres above finished floor level and permanently retained as such.
